key_difference: (D) uses the signal's function-pointer type (Func1) as the completeness-check uniquifier, which is the same in every TU, so the cross-TU ODR folding problem Fabian raised remains. (B) uses an anonymous-namespace UniqueType that is threaded through TypeIsSuitableForMetaType into is_complete. (D) also lacks (B)'s explicit pointer-to-incomplete and reference checks, so these cases fall through to qTryMetaTypeInterfaceForType instead of cleanly returning nullptr.
